## 11. Constructive finite-inertia receiver with a collision-energy guard

Root supplied this replacement for the free first-order premise; the argument
is reconstructed here. Use the SAME ordinary linear spring, write a=G*F0/3,
k=a/ell, and let the actual generalized carriage obey

m*qdd+zeta*qdot=F1+F2-P-k*q, m>0,zeta>0.

An attempt starts at reset q=0. Partner identity, lateral/angular registration
and good/bad class remain fixed; the prescribed normal stroke changes the gap
within its warranted interval. There are no unbudgeted impulses;
ordinary continuous disturbances are included in the force bands. The reset
stop dissipates the return energy without an unbudgeted outward rebound.
This is an explicit CAPTURE/OWNERSHIP/KINETIC contract, not provided by the
magnetic source. It differs materially from assuming arbitrary damping means
zero inertia, and is investigated by bounding effective impact energy.

ILLEGAL rejection: during outward motion v>=0, define
E=m*v^2/2+a*q+k*q^2/2. Since F1+F2-P<=-a,
dE/dt=v*(F1+F2-P+a)-zeta*v^2<=0.
At v=0 and q>0 acceleration is strictly negative, so outward motion cannot
restart before reset. Thus incoming kinetic energy

K0 < a*ell+k*ell^2/2 = G*F0*ell/2

guarantees that an illegal attempt stops SHORT of engagement and returns to
reset. This permits finite inertia and arbitrary force variation within the
illegal band; it does not handle a previous legal owner changing mid-attempt.
For outward initial speed v0, time to turning is <=m*v0/a. After turning,
the comparison below, reflected, gives reset time <=ell*zeta/a+m/zeta.

LEGAL completion: from rest and for 0<=q<=ell, total force is >=a. Hence
v(t)>=a/zeta*(1-exp(-zeta*t/m)) and
q(t)>=a/zeta*[t-m/zeta*(1-exp(-zeta*t/m))]. It therefore engages within

Tlegal <= ell*zeta/a+m/zeta.

No external timing schedule is needed. The incoming rest/energy, capture,
reset-stop, force/stroke and latch promises remain empirical/design inputs.
For the illustrative soft bands F0=.16N,ell=5um, the exact allowed incoming
energy is <59.52nJ. This is a target SPECIFICATION, not measured collision
energy in either source. Effective carriage mass, transmission of whole-body
impact, output work and ambient impulses must be included. Root's finite-
inertia suggestion is credited; priority versus ordinary damped connector
design is not claimed. The consumer checks the exact energy threshold and

statement: For m qdd+zeta qdot=F1+F2-P-kq with a=G F0/3 and k=a/ell, incoming K0<G F0 ell/2 prevents illegal engagement. Legal loading from rest completes within3ell*zeta/(G F0)+m/zeta. At K0<=G F0 ell/4 illegal motion stops before0.6ell, leaving0.4ell clearance.
